command:
set -eu; F=$HOME/.local/share/frank-chatgpt-organ/f2wp1207_chatgpt_github_proxy.py; cp -a "$F" "$F.pre-target-binding"; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path.home()/'.local/share/frank-chatgpt-organ/f2wp1207_chatgpt_github_proxy.py'
s=p.read_text()
old='            "command_id": command_id,
            "op": "exec",'
new='            "command_id": command_id,
            "machine_id": "ai-core-node",
            "owner": "gabriel",
            "op": "exec",'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old2='payload = {"prompt": prompt, "num_workers": max(1, min(30, int(num_workers or 1)))}'
new2='payload = {"prompt": prompt, "num_workers": 1}'
assert s.count(old2)==1
s=s.replace(old2,new2,1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
python3 -m py_compile "$F"; grep -nE 'machine_id|owner|num_workers.*1' "$F" | head -20; sha256sum "$F"
